## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title and every commit follow [Conventional Commits](../CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-messages)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Works offline
- [ ] Works alongside the previous version on another device
- [ ] Permission checks in place for any new action
- [ ] Docs and translation keys updated
- [ ] A decision record added for any significant design choice
